evidence.title: Get a DESIGN.md From Any Website URL | Design Extractor
DESIGN.md Examples from Real Websites | Design Extractor

name: Design Extractor
summary: Paste any website URL and get a DESIGN.md file: colors, typography, spacing and component tokens for AI coding agents.
description: Extracts a site's design system into a DESIGN.md that follows Google's DESIGN.md spec: YAML front matter with colour, typography and spacing tokens plus a markdown body with rationale, across eight sections (Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation and Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts). A Lite tier covers the submitted page and Pro around five pages; results can be previewed, copied, downloaded, edited and re-extracted from a history.
contains: URL in, DESIGN.md out (Lite: the page; Pro: about five pages)
extracts color palette, typography, spacing and shape tokens plus component patterns
gallery of pre-extracted specs from Stripe, Linear, Notion, Anthropic, Airbnb and IKEA, filterable by category and style
Chrome extension and MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or the Claude Agent SDK
